_about: Planetary target sites. Each value is a 0-1 score on the SAME axis used for Earth sites. Physical planetary values are projected onto Earth's attainable range and saturate at 1 (e.g. lunar vacuum -> thin_air = 1). 'facts' and 'sources' document the NASA/agency datasets that justify each profile.

targets.name: Shackleton – de Gerlache ridge (Artemis south pole)
facts: Illuminated up to ~80-90% of the year on ridge peaks (LOLA)
Permanently shadowed craters < 40 K (Diviner)
Water-ice signatures in PSRs (LRO LAMP, LCROSS, M3)
Anorthositic highland regolith, slopes 10-30° (LOLA)

targets.name: Malapert Massif (Artemis III candidate)
facts: ~5 km high massif with continuous Earth visibility
High illumination fraction near the summit
Close to cold traps with possible ice

targets.name: Mare Tranquillitatis pit (radar-confirmed cave)
facts: ~100 m pit with conduit confirmed by Mini-RF radar (2024)
Cave floor stays near ~17 °C while surface swings -170/+120 °C (Diviner)
Natural radiation and micrometeoroid shield for a base

targets.name: Jezero Crater (Perseverance)
facts: Ancient lake with river delta (CTX/HiRISE)
Carbonates and clays (CRISM)
Mean T ≈ -60 °C, P ≈ 0.6 kPa (MEDA)

targets.name: Gale Crater – Mount Sharp (Curiosity)
facts: 5 km sedimentary mound with clays → sulfates
Surface radiation dose ≈ 0.67 mSv/day (RAD)
Diurnal ΔT up to 90 K (REMS)

targets.name: Arcadia Planitia (human-base ice target)
facts: Shallow excess ice < 1 m deep (SWIM / SHARAD)
Flat, low-elevation plains – safe landing
Fresh ice-exposing impact craters (HiRISE)

radar_ice.text: MRO SHARAD + SWIM: excess ice within ~1 m of the surface (Morgan et al. 2021)

targets.name: Deuteronilus Mensae (debris-covered glaciers)
facts: Lobate debris aprons that are > 90% water ice (SHARAD)
Mesas and scarps along the dichotomy boundary

radar_ice.text: MRO SHARAD radar: debris aprons are >90% buried water ice (Plaut et al. 2009)

targets.name: Arsia Mons skylights (lava-tube caves)
facts: 'Seven Sisters' cave skylights 100-250 m wide (THEMIS)
Basaltic shield volcano flanks, ~9-17 km elevation

targets.name: Meridiani Planum (Opportunity)
facts: Hematite 'blueberries' and jarosite (sulfate) evaporites
Acidic, briny past groundwater
